foundationFeatures.name: Gifted Performer
foundationFeatures.text: When you play your instrument during a downtime move, you may choose a friendly player; both of you gain a Hope at the start of the next session.

foundationFeatures.name: Heart-Stirring Song
foundationFeatures.text: Once per long rest, you may perform for an ally within Close range; they clear a number of Stress equal to your Presence (minimum 1).

foundationFeatures.name: Eloquent
foundationFeatures.text: Gain a +1 bonus to rolls to persuade, deceive, or unsettle a creature that can understand you.

foundationFeatures.name: Rousing Speech
foundationFeatures.text: Once per long rest, deliver a stirring speech. Each ally within Close range may clear a Stress.

foundationFeatures.name: Elemental Incarnation
foundationFeatures.text: When you Beastform, choose an element (fire, water, earth, or air). Your beast form deals magic damage of that element type and gains a thematic minor trait (e.g., move across water, ignore difficult terrain on stone).

foundationFeatures.name: Elemental Burst
foundationFeatures.text: Once per rest, when you take damage from an elemental source, you may release a burst of the matching element; each adjacent enemy takes 1d6 mag damage.

foundationFeatures.name: Gift of Growth
foundationFeatures.text: When you make a successful spellcast roll, you may clear a Hit Point on yourself or an ally within Close range instead of dealing damage.

foundationFeatures.name: Verdant Recovery
foundationFeatures.text: When you take a short rest in a natural environment, you and any allies resting with you each clear an additional Stress.

foundationFeatures.name: Held Ground
foundationFeatures.text: When an ally within Close range takes damage, you may mark a Stress to take that damage in their place.

foundationFeatures.name: Unmoveable
foundationFeatures.text: You have advantage on rolls to resist being moved, knocked down, or grappled.

foundationFeatures.name: At Ease
foundationFeatures.text: When you take Severe damage, mark a Stress to add a d6 to your next attack roll against the source.

foundationFeatures.name: Revenge
foundationFeatures.text: Once per encounter, when an adversary deals damage to you, you can spend a Hope to immediately make an attack against them.

foundationFeatures.name: Animal Companion
foundationFeatures.text: You have a small or medium animal companion. It acts on your turn and shares your Hope, Stress, and Hit Point pools. Its features are detailed on a separate companion sheet.

foundationFeatures.name: Pack Tactics
foundationFeatures.text: When you attack an adversary that your companion is adjacent to, gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll.

foundationFeatures.name: Path Sense
foundationFeatures.text: Gain advantage on rolls to navigate, track, or determine direction in any natural or wild environment.

foundationFeatures.name: Marked for Death
foundationFeatures.text: When you mark a creature as your Ranger's Focus, you also know that creature's general location at all times while it remains within Far range.

foundationFeatures.name: Shadow Step
foundationFeatures.text: Once per rest, you may spend a Hope to teleport from one shadow to another within Close range. You appear hidden if no enemy has a direct line of sight to your destination.

foundationFeatures.name: Cloak of Shadows
foundationFeatures.text: When you take a Stress to avoid an attack, you also become hidden until the start of your next turn.

foundationFeatures.name: Contacts Everywhere
foundationFeatures.text: Once per session, declare that you know someone useful in this town, city, or organization. The GM decides exactly who they are and how willing they are to help.

foundationFeatures.name: Backup
foundationFeatures.text: When you spend a Hope to gain advantage on a Finesse roll, an unseen ally also provides assistance: the roll gains an additional +1 bonus.

foundationFeatures.name: Spirit Weapon
foundationFeatures.text: Your primary weapon is bound to a divine spirit. When you make a damage roll with it, you may add your Strength to the result a second time by spending a Hope.

foundationFeatures.name: Sacred Resolve
foundationFeatures.text: When you would mark your last Hit Point, you may mark 2 Stress instead to remain standing with 1 Hit Point. Usable once per long rest.

foundationFeatures.name: Wings
foundationFeatures.text: You have functional wings and can fly. While flying, you can move at the same speed as on the ground and ignore difficult terrain on the ground.

foundationFeatures.name: Aerial Strike
foundationFeatures.text: When you attack from above with a Strength weapon after a fly move, gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll.

foundationFeatures.name: Elemental Manipulation
foundationFeatures.text: Choose an element (fire, water, earth, air, or lightning). When you cast a damaging spell, you may change its damage type to your chosen element at no cost.

foundationFeatures.name: Elemental Armor
foundationFeatures.text: Once per long rest, when you take damage of your chosen element type, you may halve it before applying it.

foundationFeatures.name: Manipulate Magic
foundationFeatures.text: When you make a spellcast roll, you may spend a Hope to change the spell's range by one step (Close to Far, Far to Very Far, etc.).

foundationFeatures.name: Primal Surge
foundationFeatures.text: Once per rest, when you roll your damage dice for a spell, you may roll an additional damage die of the same size and add it to the total.

foundationFeatures.name: Courage
foundationFeatures.text: When you mark your last Hit Point in an encounter, you and each ally within Close range gain a Hope.

foundationFeatures.name: Battle-Hardened
foundationFeatures.text: When you would take Major damage, you may mark a Stress to reduce it to Minor damage. Usable once per encounter.

foundationFeatures.name: Slayer's Edge
foundationFeatures.text: When you score a critical hit on an attack, the target marks an additional Hit Point.

foundationFeatures.name: Bloodied Resolve
foundationFeatures.text: While you have marked half or more of your Hit Points, gain a +1 bonus to your attack and damage rolls.

foundationFeatures.name: Prepared
foundationFeatures.text: Take an extra domain card of your level or lower at character creation. It does not count against your loadout limit.

foundationFeatures.name: Adept
foundationFeatures.text: When you make a roll to recall information about a subject you have studied, you may treat any result below a 10 as if it had been a 10.

foundationFeatures.name: Battle Mage
foundationFeatures.text: Gain an additional Hit Point slot at character creation. You may also wear chainmail or leather armor without spellcasting penalty.

foundationFeatures.name: Face Your Fate
foundationFeatures.text: Once per long rest, when you fail a spellcast roll, you may spend a Hope to treat it as a success instead, marking 2 Stress.
